summary: First test round for ISNAD Arabic RTL logistics platform. Backend + frontend tested. Found and fixed one CRITICAL backend bug in require_roles dependency that broke all authenticated POST endpoints. After fix, 22/22 backend tests pass and all frontend flows verified.

critical.endpoint: ALL authenticated POST endpoints (business/*, worker/*, admin/* mutations)
critical.issue: require_roles inner checker declared `user: dict = None, request: Request = None` — FastAPI treated `user` as a Body parameter, so it required an embedded `{body: {...}, user: {...}}` payload and returned 422 'body: Field required' for every real request. Fixed by removing the misleading `user: dict = None` param from the checker. This bug rendered request creation, offer accept/reject, attendance, complete, cancel, rate, topup, withdraw, admin match, admin withdrawal decision, broadcast, ticket create/reply etc. completely non-functional.

design_issues.screen: Any protected route landing before login
issues: Two 401 console errors on load (GET /api/auth/me before token) — cosmetic; consider suppressing or short-circuiting when no token exists

action_items: Bug already fixed in /app/backend/deps.py (require_roles checker). Please review the fix.
Optional: silence the /api/auth/me 401 console noise before authentication.
critical_code_review_comments: deps.require_roles had a parameter signature that FastAPI interpreted as Body — this is a recurring dependency-injection pitfall; adding a comment or using explicit `Depends(get_current_user)` would harden it.

Endpoints return raw Mongo documents including string `_id`. Since _id is string-generated via new_id() (not ObjectId), it's JSON-serializable and fine, but exposing internal _id verbatim on user objects (including full worker_profile/business_profile) also leaks nullable phone/email. Consider a public serializer.
OTP endpoint returns `demo_otp` unconditionally — acceptable for demo build, but flag before production.
Business /business/estimate & /requests do not verify DURATIONS.get returns None fallback for unknown duration_type — currently mitigated by Literal validator, OK.
No rate-limiting on OTP endpoint — a real deployment must add throttling.

rca of the issue: RCA: In /app/backend/deps.py, `require_roles` returned an inner async `checker(user: dict = None, request: Request = None)`. FastAPI's dependency system inspects parameters by type: `Request` is auto-injected, but `user: dict = None` was interpreted as an unresolved parameter that FastAPI treats as a Body parameter (dict is a JSON body type by default with no Depends/Query annotation). Because the endpoint had BOTH its own `body: EstimateIn` (or similar) AND this second dict body param `user`, FastAPI switched to 'embedded body mode' and expected `{"body": {...}, "user": {...}}`. Every real request only sent the natural body, so validation returned 422 with loc=['body','body']. Reproduction: any authenticated POST like /api/business/estimate with a valid token returned 422. Mitigation: removed `user: dict = None` from the checker so only `request: Request` remains (properly auto-injected). All authenticated POST endpoints now respond correctly.
